balls.text: palmed over the bar, oh dear! Slower ball that sits up to be hit just outside off. Unadkat stands up tall and slams it towards long on. Harshal makes an absolute hash of it and pushes it over the fence too!

straight to long off! In the slot outside off, and it is there to be hit. Bhuvneshwar gives it everything he has but clinks it off the toe-end. Bairstow takes a few paces in from long off, and does the rest. The new batter will be on strike for the final ball!
off-pace on a length on leg stump. Bhuvneshwar tugs it towards deep mid wicket and picks up a brace
into the blockhole outside off. Shahbaz can only squeeze it out towards extra cover
slower delivery dug into the track outside off. Bhuvneshwar swipes it away towards deep mid wicket
slower ball on a length way outside off. Shahbaz walks across his stumps and drills it towards long off. Just a single
back of a length just outside off. Shahbaz lets the ball arrive before tapping it towards point. Retains strike for the start of the final over
what a shot! Right in the slot outside off and Shahbaz climbs into it. Bends his back knee to get elevation and crunches it over deep cover!
slower bouncer that goes awry and sails over the batter's head. Called a wide
vital boundary! Too much width outside off, and Shahbaz picks the slower ball too. Waits for it and scythes it past backward point, who got a hand to it but could not get enough behind it
juicy full toss outside off and Arshdeep gets away with this. Shahbaz laced his cover drive but hit it straight to the fielder at extra cover
very full outside off. Bhuvneshwar digs it out towards deep cover point
length outside off. Bhuvneshwar comes onto the front foot and times it beautifully past extra cover. Rabada gives chase from long off and reins it in via a dive
angled in on a back of a length on leg stump. Bhuvneshwar is late on the stroke and the ball pings off the thigh pad into the on side
another beauty! This is proper Test match bowling. Pitches on a length on off. Nips away against the angle, squares up the batter and beats him comprehensively
back of a length in the channel. Straightens after pitching and breezes past the outside edge of the bat

Rabada has his first! Slower ball on a length on middle and off. Cummins clears his front leg and swings for the hills. Loses his shape completely and loses his stumps soon after. PBKS keep chipping away, and they are now in with a real chance to restrict SRH to a total under 170!
slower bumper on middle and leg. Too high for the umpire's liking, though, and called a wide
safe! Dug into the track on middle and leg. Cummins has a swipe across the line but the ball gets big on him. Splices it but luckily for him, it falls well short of deep mid wicket
back of a length just outside off. Cummins hops up onto his toes and dabs it towards backward point
very full outside off. Cummins comes forward and pushes it towards deep cover point

Two wickets in the over for the second time today for Arshdeep! Rank full toss, bowled a mile outside off, perhaps because of where Nitish is standing. He tries to muscle it over long off but the bat turns in his hand upon contact. Hits it straight down Rabada's throat at long off, adn that brings to an end a superb innings!
back of a length on middle and leg. Shahbaz tucks it off his pads towards deep mid wicket

holes out to deep backward point! Arshdeep set the trap, and he executes to perfection. Full and wide outside off. Samad flays at it but cannot control his stroke. Slices it and Harshal is stationed on the fence for exactly that stroke. A simple catch, and PBKS break what was looking like a threatening partnership!

full and wide outside off. Samad has a massive swing at it and misses. Was a touch-and-go call on the wide, and SRH opt to go upstairs. The ball was just beyond the tramlines but because the batter was standing just outside off, Alex Wharf says it is a fair delivery!
the runs are flowing! Arshdeep seems to nail the wide yorker, but Samad has a riposte ready. Jams down on it with an open bat face and glides it past the diving Jitesh for four!
off-pace delivery dug into the track outside off. Samad stands tall and flat-bats it towards long off
four more! Full on the pads, and that is another freebie. Samad just uses the pace and glances it through the backward square leg region!
what power! Slow, short, wide and begging to be hit. Samad picks it up really early, stands tall and slaps it to deep cover point's right!
shortish on the pads. Samad waits for it and tucks it off his hips towards deep mid wicket
angled in on a length on the stumps. Nitish bunts it down the ground and calls for two. They decide against it in the end

falls in no man's land! Hard length just outside off. Samad looks to go over long off but mistimes it horribly. Gets just enough, though, to get it over Dhawan, who was running back from extra cover towards mid off
short and wide outside off. Nitish goes back and scuffs it towards deep cover point for a couple of runs. Excellent running
Nitish Kumar Reddy is turning it on! Lobbed up into the slot outside off and Nitish cannot believe what he is being served up. Clean swing through the line and he pumps it flat over long off!

dropped, oh dear! Dragged down on middle and off. Nitish rocks back and pulls it uppishly. The ball flies towards deep mid wicket, where Shashank puts it down to his left. To make matters worse, it trickles into the fence!
watch out in the crowd! Full toss on leg stump and that is a help-yourself ball. Nitish obliges and launches it over wide long on. Maiden IPL fifty for Nitish!
brilliant batting! Brar senses Nitish looking for the reverse, and fires it very full on the stumps. Nitish goes through with it anyway and smacks it over backward point!
full outside off. Nitish whips it back at the bowler, who gets a hand to it and saves a few runs
hard length on middle and off. Samad gets up on his toes and plays it back to the bowler
slower bumper outside off. Balloons over the batter's head, and called a wide
lovely! Leg-stump half-volley and Samad cashes in. Springs onto the front foot and clips it wonderfully past mid wicket for four!
slashed over backward point! Full outside off and Samad needed no second invitation. Gave it all he had and cleared the fielder comfortably!
off-pace on a length outside off. Nitish pushes it towards backward point for a single
full on the pads. Samad uses the angle and glances it down to fine leg to get off the mark

Harshal gets the big fish, and this is a huge moment in the game! Length ball on middle and off, and this seems to just hold in the surface a little. Klaasen tries to go downtown but miscues it. Clinks it off the bottom part of the bat, and arrows it straight to Curran at long off, who makes no mistake. PBKS are jubilant, SRH not quite!
length outside off. Nitish sits back in his crease and has a massive swish at it. Only connects with fresh air, though
short and wide outside off. Klaasen reaches out for it and cuts it towards deep cover point
lots of width outside off. Klaasen throws his hands at it and drills it towards deep cover point
off-pace on a back of a length on off. Klaasen is cramped for room and jams it towards extra cover
length delivery well outside off. Nitish moves across his stumps and drives it on the up towards deep cover point
six more! A proper half-tracker. Sits up to be hit on leg stump and Nitish pounds it over the deep backward square leg fence!
shortish outside off. A bit of extra bounce. Nitish takes his bottom hand off the bat to ride it, dropping it into the off side for a single
into the crowd! Another short ball but this is a shade down leg. Nitish gets inside the line, goes up and under, and hooks it cleanly over long leg!
dug in short on leg stump. Gets a little big on Klaasen but he does well to fend it into the ground on the leg side. Picks up a single
hard length on off. Klaasen jumps up onto his toes and drops it right beside him with soft hands
back of a length outside off. Nitish gets on top of the bounce and guides it down to third man
back of a length on middle and leg. Nitish gets up on his toes and defends

just evades Curran at long on! Floated up into the slot on leg stump. Klaasen plants his front foot and goes through the line. Does not quite middle it and Curran, running to his left from long on, is very interested. He puts in a full-stretch dive but canont get there!
length outside off. Klaasen hangs back and stabs it towards short extra cover
back of a length outside off. Nitish stays back and taps it gently into the off side for a single
four followed by a six! A proper buffet ball. Short and outside leg. Nitish cannot believe his luck. Hops back and pummels it over deep backward square leg!
shot! A touch slower and perhaps shorter too, which allows Nitish to rock back, free his arms enough and crash it to backward point's right!
shortish just outside off. Skids on and cramps Nitish for room. He scuffs his cut towards backward point
slower ball on a length outside off. Nitish comes forward and dabs it down to third man
back of a length outside off. Klaasen waits for it and runs it down to third man

banged into the track outside off. Looks like a slower ball because this balloons past Tripathi. He tries to upper-cut it and misses. Curran is very interested and he thinks there is bat involved. The PKS fielders get together, and they go upstairs. There is indeed a nick. A clear spike as the ball is next to the bat and Tripathi, in fact, seemed to walk as soon as PBKS reviewed it. Strange sequence of events, but what matters is that SRH are now four down!
back of a length outside off. Nitish gets on top of the bounce and punches it neatly towards deep cover point
slow and short outside of. Tripathi reaches out for it and dabs it towards deep cover point
length on off. Nitish comes half forward and drops it into the off side for a single
angled into the pads. Nitish goes back to this shortish ball and helps it towards deep mid wicket. He wanted the second too but was sent back, in time
back of a length just outside off. Not much room to work with for Nitish and he jabs it towards short extra cover
given a bit of air, on a length just outside leg. Tripathi advances and drills it to long on
shortish just outside off. Nitish hops back and pulls it down to long on
full on middle and leg. Tripathi gets down on one knee and swipes it towards deep mid wicket
length on middle and off. Nitish opts to stay back and knocks it down to long on
length just outside off. Tripathi presses half forward and drives on the up through point. Harshal makes up ground on the fence, slides to his left and keeps it down to two
back of a length outside off. Tripathi skips down the track and jabs it towards deep cover point. He is intent on the second and has to scramble to make his ground
back of a length just outside off. Keeps a little low but Nitish adjusts well to push it past extra cover
back of a length on off. Nitish gets behind the line and presents the full face of the bat
short again, and this is wider outside off. Nitish laces his cut but cannot get it past backward point. Good stop by Harpreet Brar
first boundary for Nitish! Dug into the track outside off. Sits up and Nitish rocks back to hammer this over mid wicket!
shortish on middle and leg. Nitish stays back and punches it towards deep mid wicket
angled in on a length on leg stump. Tripathi plays all over it and the ball pings off his pads into the on side
finds the gap! Short just outside off and there is enough width to work with for Tripathi. He rocks back, delays his stroke and splits the fielders at backward point and short third!
back of a length on middle and off. Skids on with the angle and raps Tripathi on the pads. Going down leg, though

was there a nick?! Back of a length delivery well outside off. Tripathi shuffles across, trying to paddle it. Might have just grazed the bat or the glove on the way. Jitesh could not gather, so it became immaterial anyway
back of a length on the stumps. Nitish goes back and knocks it down to long on

angled into leg stump. Tripathi swings at it and misses. Seems to clip the pad on the way through to the keeper but called a wide by umpire Nikhil Patwardhan. PBKS review immediately. And they are vindicated. The ball clearly stuck the thigh pad, and that is the end of the over.

short and hung up well outside off. Tripathi wanders down the track and then wafts at it. Makes no contact and Jitesh shows good awareness and skill to throw down the stumps at the batter's end. Tripathi was well in, though
back of a length on off. Tripathi lets the ball come to him before meeting it right under his eyes
full and swinging away well outside off. Tripathi goes chasing after it and is beaten on the outside
full outside off again. Nitish drives it crisply towards short extra cover, who dives to his left. Cannot stop it cleanly, though, and Nitish gets off the mark
full on off stump. Nitish comes forward and pokes it into the off side

did that carry? PBKS are celebrating! Back of a length outside off. Abhishek marches down the track, trying to carve it over cover. Steps too far outside leg, though, and gets it right off the toe-end. Floats towards cover point, where Shashank dives forward and snares a sharp chance!
four more! Curran tries to go fuller and into the stumps but ends up straying onto the pads. Abhishek snaps his wrists into the stroke and flicks it over mid on!
glorious! Up in the slot outside off, and that is just what Abhishek is waiting for. Holds his shape, goes through the line and creams it over extra cover!
length delivery in the fifth stump channel. Abhishek watches this go through to the keeper

shortish outside off and this swings away a great deal. Abhishek hares down the track and nearly swings himself off his feet. Only connects with fresh air. To spare his blushes, the umpire calls it a wide
length outside off. Abhishek comes forward and lets it go
oh dear! Length on off. Swerves away very late. Abhishek tries to whip it over mid on but sees the ball whiz past his flailing blade
another play and miss! Back of a length in the channel just outside off. Goes on with the angle and draws Nitish into a nibble. Breezes past the outside edge in the end
short and wide outside off. Nitish flashes hard at it and misses. Called a wide, though
back of a length delivery pushed across the batter outside off. Nitish watches it go through to the keeper

Arshdeep has two in the over, and SRH are rocking early! Back of a length in the channel, and this seems to jag away just a smidgen. Markram's feet go nowhere and he wafts at it. Feathers it through to Jitesh. The nick is acknowledged, and PBKS have two in very quick succession!
full and swinging away outside off. Markram comes forward and drives it towards short extra cover

gone this time! Dhawan makes it look very easy! Full just outside off and Head's eyes light up. He tries to smash it to Chandigarh but loses his shape, cutting across it in the process. The ball goes straight up and Dhawan does brilliantly to track it over his shoulder from mid off. Keeps his eyes on the ball as it drops, and snaffles it up, with minimal fuss. Massive moment in the game!
another chance! Back of a length just outside off. Abhishek drops it into the off side and calls for the single. A direct hit, and he would have been gone!
hard length, cramping the batter for room outside leg. Head somehow tugs it away past square leg and picks up another brace
full just outside off. Head gives himself plenty of room and throws the plumbing at it. Slices it and it clears cover, who was running back. Head gets a couple for his toil
short and wide outside off. Zips off the surface and beats Head for pace as he tries to upper-cut it
three fours in a row! Right up in the slot on middle and leg. Head clears his front leg again and lofts it comfortably over mid on!
Travis Head special! Hard length just outside off. Head stands up on his toes, stays leg side and flays it past backward point for four!
an inside edge now! Full on the pads. Head clears his front leg and swings his blade like an axe. Gets an inside edge that flashes past the keeper!
length outside off. More swing away from Abhishek and he does not fiddle with this one

safe again! And it races away for four! Back of a length outside off. Moves away late and tempts Abhishek into a loose prod away from his body. Slices it a tad and just manages to beat backward point to his right!
length delivery outside off that shapes away. Abhishek lets it go
length well outside off. Head goes deep into his crease and drills it towards mid off, where Dhawan dives to his left and saves a certain boundary
shortish outside off. Sticks in the surface a touch and Head scuffs it down the ground
streaky! Back of a length outside off. Abhishek has a waft at it away from his body and squirts it off the inside edge towards fine leg
back of a length on middle and off. Head stays leg side and jabs it towards point
back of a length, probing just outside off. Head goes fishing at it and is beaten all ends up
oh! Back of a length in the channel, and this one curves back in devilishly. Head, trying to force it through the off side, is cut in half
Head is up and away! Full, wide and with that sort of width, Head was always going to give it the lot. Does not middle it and the ball flies off the outside edge over slip!
shorter outside off. Head tries to throw his hands at it but this one does not bounce a lot. Does not even carry to Jitesh

huge appeal, and not given! This is an absolute peach first up. Threatens to shape in from leg on a length, only to pitch and deck away slightly. Opens up Head completely, and does him all ends up. Might have flicked the back leg on the way hence causing the noise. UltraEdge confirms there was bat involved, and had PBKS reviewed, Head would have been on his way! The keeper went up straightaway but there was not a lot of support from elsewhere.

Shashank finishes off with a six, but the Punjab Kings fall two runs short in this epic encounter! Another slot ball on off, and Unadkat gets met. Shashank swings through the line and clobbers it over long off. Smiles in the SRH dugout, they have scraped through this contest. Spare a thought for the Punjab Kings and this particular batting pair, who, after their exploits the other day, almost did the unthinkable tonight!

dropped again, but the important bit is that this has not cleared the fence! Slower ball on a back of a length on off. Ashutosh waits an eternity for it before hoicking it towards deep mid wicket. Tripathi puts down the catch but it is just a brace
slow, short and outside the tramlines on the off side. Called a wide again. Oh my, this game is twisting and turning every moment!
another slower bumper outside off. Ashutosh gives it all he has but the lack of pace means he can only pull it on the bounce to deep mid wicket
slower delivery dug into the track outside off. Ashutosh swings himself off his feet and drags it towards deep mid wicket. Scrambles back for two and makes it

palmed over the bar again, what is happening here in Mullanpur?! Right up in the slot on middle and off. Ashutosh lays back deep in his crease and snaps through the line, banging it towards long off, who pushes it over!
slow, short and beyond the tramlines again on the off side. More exercise for the umpire, and Unadkat is feeling the pinch
and now the wide! The pressure is on! Wide yorker goes wrong and Unadkat sprays it way outside off. Called a wide

palmed over the bar! Final-over deja-vu! Half-tracker outside off and Ashutosh smashes the cover off this. Gets it right out of the middle and bludgeons it towards deep mid wicket, where Nitish helps it over the fence!
perfect yorker to end the over! Gets the length right, and also the line. Just inside the tramlines and Shashank, despite his best attempts to jam down, cannot do so in time
innovation at its best! Low full toss well outside off. Shashank, like his partner, reads that line and shapes for the scoop. Gets enough on it and beats short fine leg!
another top wide yorker. Ashutosh plays with an open bat face and slices it towards deep backward point
right up in the blockhole on off. Ashutosh can only squeeze it out towards the bowler
oh my days, this is a shot and a half! Natarajan bowls it a mile outside off. Ashutosh works it out in time and goes down on one knee. Fetches it from that wide line and clubs it to long on's right!
nails the wide yorker first up. Shashank cannot get under it and digs it out towards deep backward point
full on middle and off. Ashutosh sits deep in his crease and smashes it straight to the fielder at mid off. Dot ball
safe! Hard length outside off. Shashank tries to muscle it over long on but does not get all of it. On the bounce to long on
another off-pace ball, dug into the track on leg stump. Ashutosh is cramped for room and slogs it towards mid wicket
Ashutosh is toying with Cummins now! Slower short ball outside off. Ashutosh has read this like the morning daily too and ramps it over the keeper's head!

that has gone to the fence like a tracer bullet! Shortish outside off. Ashutosh picks the length early, backs away, stands tall and blasts it past deep cover point, who barely had to move a couple of yards, but still could not get there!
hard length on off. Comes on quicker and hits the bat hard. Shashank shanks it towards deep mid wicket
gets the line right this time. Full enough to prevent Shashank from getting under it and he squeezes it out to deep backward point

full and wide again, beyond the tramlines. More exercise for the umpire. Klaasen is adamant it should not be a wide, and SRH review! Shashank has moved across his stumps, and the ball was only just beyond the tramlines. But the decision has been upheld. Not sure what Bhuvneshwar did wrong there, but the decision goes against SRH!
length delivery bowled a mile outside off, perhaps as a response to Shashank shaping for the scoop. Well beyond the tramlines and called a wide
third four in the over! PBKS are coming after SRH! Short, wide and put away. That much width is always asking for trouble and Shashank smacks it past extra cover!
back of a length outside off. Ashutosh hangs back deep and scuffs it down the ground to long off
low full toss on the pads. Shashank can only flick it towards deep mid wicket. Just a single
back to back boundaries! Goes for the wide yorker but errs on the shorter side. Shashank sits deep in his crease and cracks it past extra cover!
streaky but they all count! Back of a length outside off. Shashank throws the plumbing at it and the ball skews off the outside edge over short third!
slower ball dug into the track just outside off. Ashutosh looks for the upper-cut but has no pace to work with. Fails to make contact
slow, short and following the batter outside leg. Shashank swipes it towards deep square leg
short on leg stump. Ashutosh swivels on this slower bouncer and helps it down to fine leg

Jitesh holes out, and Nitish rises to the occasion again! Slower bumper on leg stump that is actually begging to be hit. Jitesh tries to smash it into next week and swings too early. Gets it right off the toe-end and rather than flying over fine leg, it spoons up towards deep square leg. Abhishek comes running in off the fence, slides forward and completes the catch! PBKS keep slipping!
fetch that! Hard length outside off. Jitesh skips down the track, stands tall and boshes it over the long off fence!
back of a length delivery well down leg. Jitesh swings and misses. Called a wide

another miscue, and Natarajan shells it! Back of a length, slanting into leg stump. Jitesh has a swipe at it and the ball goes straight up off the top edge. Natarajan circles under it nervously from third man and over-runs it in the end. Has to snatch at it to his left and he grasses it!
dug in again, outside off. Jitesh moves across and mows it towards deep mid wicket
banged into the track well outside off. Jitesh lets it go, hoping for the wide but does not get any favours
Jitesh breaks free! Too much width outside off. Jitesh waits for the ball to arrive, throws his hands at it and carves it over extra cover!
width outside off again. Shashank stands up tall to this back of a length ball and flays it towards deep cover point
shortish on off. Jitesh steps down the track and slaps it towards deep cover point
back of a length outside off. Shashank throws his hands at it and toe-ends it down to third man
back of a length outside off. Jitesh goes feeling for it away from his body and the ball sneaks past the outside edge
slower bumper on middle and leg that just does not arrive. Jitesh has to wait an eternity before gloving it down to fine leg
dug in shorter outside off. Jitesh gets onto the back foot and heaves it over mid wicket for a couple of runs
hard length on leg stump. Shashank backs away and drops the ball into the off side for a sharpish single
back of a length on the pads. Jitesh works it into the square leg region and gets off the mark

Raza looks for the boundary, and perishes for the cause! Slower ball on a back of a length on off. Raza has decided a week early he wants to play the lap. Gets into position but the lack of pace meddles with his timing. Can only scoop it straight up, and Klaasen accepts the offering gleefully. Vital wicket for SRH!
Cummins cannot close out the over well! Back of a length, angling into off stump. Shashank gives himself ample room and knifes it past backward point for four!
short and wide outside off. Raza laces this one but picks out the sweeper at deep cover point
hard length outside off again. Raza hacks it back to the bowler
hard length just outside off. Raza tries to go inside out but is cramped for room. Clinked back to the bowler
shortish outside off. Shashank waits for it and dabs it to third man
back of a length just outside off. Raza hops up onto his toes and runs it down to third man
fuller on off. Raza comes forward and pushes it towards deep extra cover
short and wide outside off. Raza tries to hit it too hard and ends up chopping it off the under-edge towards the keeper
pick the bones out of this one! Back of a length on leg stump, and Raza tears into it. Gets down on one knee and clatters it over deep square leg!
fired into the pads again. Shashank tucks it away towards deep mid wicket
back of a length on leg stump. Raza waits for it and stabs it towards deep mid wicket
full on the pads. Shashank comes forward and works it away towards deep mid wicket
banged in shorter on middle stump. Shashank gets into a bit of a tangle and miscues it towards fine leg
hard length, denying the batter any room on middle and leg. Shashank advances and taps it towards extra cover
back of a length on off. Raza jabs it towards mid off and hares across to the other end
hard length, angling into middle and off. No room to work with for Raza and he prods it towards the bowler
slanted in on a length on middle and leg. Raza cuts himself off a little and pokes it towards mid wicket
Raza clears the fence! Off-pace and to be fair, this is a half-tracker outside off. Raza waits for it and then shovels it over deep mid wicket!

back of a length on the stumps. Shashank tips it to short mid wicket and sets off for a single. The fielder takes his eyes off it and misfields, conceding the second in the process. Had he gathered cleanly, there might have been a run-out chance at the bowler's end
hard length on middle and leg. Shashank presses half forward and turns it towards short mid wicket
cleverly done! Shortish just outside off. Shashank arches his back to create room and then ramps it high to the keeper's right!
short and wide outside off. Raza scuffs it into the off side and calls his partner through. The fielder at backward point has a shy at the batter's end and misses
back of a length on leg stump. Shashank gets inside the line and eases it out into the on side

and Natarajan answers SRH's prayers! A blinder by Cummins at mid off! Hard length outside off, and this seems to rush off the pitch quicker than Curran anticipates. Hacks across the line and mistimes it. For the longest while, it seems it will evade Cummins at mid off until....he leaps up like a salmon high to his left and takes it with both hands. What a moment in the game, and SRH's captain has come up trumps!
back of a length outside off. Curran gets on top of the bounce and punches it neatly towards deep cover point
short, wide and punished! Too much width and that is asking for trouble with third man and backward point up. Curran flashes hard at it and slashes it over the third man fence!
slower ball on a back of a length outside off. Curran slaps it straight to short extra cover
full on the pads. Raza gets forward and flicks it down to long on
back of a length outside off. Curran stays back and jabs it towards deep cover point
length outside off. Curran does not move his feet much, punching it down the ground to mid off
length on off. Curran shimmies around his crease before working it into the mid wicket region
banged in short on middle and off. This is an on-pace ball and Curran sways out of the way
slower bumper outside off that just does not arrive. Raza drags it towards mid wicket, who misfields and ends up conceding the single
hard length just outside off. Raza, in trying to work to leg, plays a little too early and misses it altogether
back of a length on middle and leg. Curran tucks it off his hips towards deep mid wicket
into the stands! Long-hop just outside off and Curran capitalises again. Stands up on his toes and whacks it over mid wicket!
up and over! Length on middle and off. Raza comes out of his bunker, gets his hands through the ball and lifts it over mid off!

edged and four! Back of a length outside off. A hint of nip away and that induces the outside edge as Raza nibbles at it. There is no slip in place, though, and the ball races away into the third man fence!
full on middle and off. Raza comes forward and plays it back to the bowler
shortish on middle and leg. Curran pushes it to mid wicket's left and picks up a single
length on middle and off. Curran goes deep into his crease before patting it gently into the off side
Curran welcomes Nitish with a boundary! Half-tracker on off stump and Curran pounces. Picks up the length early and belts it over mid wicket!
sticks to the same line and length outside off. Curran stands tall and eases it out to deep point
back of a length outside off. Curran cannot time it well again and skews it into the off side
hard length outside off. Curran scuffs his back-foot punch towards extra cover
just over! Dug in shorter just outside off. Curran is rushed on the pull but manages to hack it just over Cummins at mid on
back of a length on off. Curran hangs back and stabs it towards mid on
gets it through! Full just outside off. Curran plants his front foot and muscles it past the fielder at mid on. Much-needed boundary!
angled in on a length on off. Raza comes forward and pushes it towards mid on
back of a length outside off. Nips away off the pitch and Raza lets it go

stumped! Top-drawer bowling, and even better keeping! Length in the channel just outside off. Despite Klaasen being up, Dhawan decides to wander down the track. Nibbles at it and is beaten by the slight away movement. Klaasen keeps his eyes on the ball, collects cleanly and then whips off the bails in a flash. PBKS in all sorts of trouble now!
back of a length on middle and off. Dhawan comes half forward and defends
put down, oh dear! Back of a length in the channel, and with the keeper up to the stumps, Dhawan has a flat-footed prod at it. Gets a healthy outside edge that is grassed by Samad at first slip!
back of a length on middle and leg. Dhawan dances down the track and punches it crisply through cover for a couple of runs
hard length just outside off. Comes onto Curran quicker than he expects and he splices his attempted pull towards mid wicket
banged in short on middle and off. Curran gauges it early enough and ducks under it
length outside off. Dhawan goes fishing at it again and slices it down to deep backward point
back of a length outside off. Curran nibbles at it away from his body and squirts it off the inside edge past the stumps
just short! Dug into the track outside off. Dhawan advances and throws his hands at it. Flays it on the bounce to deep backward point
length just outside off. Dhawan comes half forward and pokes it back towards the bowler

this goes straight up, and Bhuvneshwar has his man! Length in the fifth stump channel. Seems destined to angle in but straightens just a shade after pitching. Prabhsimran walks down the track and looks to whip it away over mid wicket. Skews it off the leading edge, and Nitish, running back from cover point, gobbles it up. SRH have two in the powerplay!
off the mark in style! Hard length on middle and leg. Prabhsimran decides to skip down early and then goes through with the stroke. Does not middle it but gets enough to clear mid on!
back of a length on off. Prabhsimran hares down the track and then hacks it agriculturally towards mid on
length outside off. Prabhsimran advances, trying to go inside out. Gets a thick inside edge that thuds into his pads
back of a length on middle and leg. Dhawan gets inside the line and glances it down to fine leg
breaks the shackles! Back of a length on off. Dhawan marches down the track and cracks it past cover point for four!
hard length just outside off. Prabhsimran gets on top of the bounce and pushes it towards mid off
back of a length outside off. Prabhsimran hops up onto his toes and defends

cleans him up!! Hard length, bowled at 141.1kph. Slants into off stump and Bairstow, trying to impose himself, swipes across the line in ungainly fashion. Only swats away a few flies and hears the death rattle soon after. The move to share the new ball has worked a charm for Cummins, and this is just what SRH would have wanted!
back of a length outside off. A bit of nip away from Bairstow and he wafts at fresh air
hard length just outside off. Dhawan stabs at it and jams it off the inside edge into his pads. Rolls away for a single
length just outside off. Dhawan sits back in his crease and punches it on the up towards short extra cover
lots of swing! Back of a length outside off. Bairstow advances, trying to get close to the ball. It keeps leaving him, though, and breezes past the outside edge
another fullish delivery swinging into the pads. Dhawan misses his flick for the second ball running and the ball deflects off the pads for a leg bye
length on leg stump. Dhawan plays all over his flick and gets pinged on the pads
full on middle and off. Dhawan comes forward and pushes it towards short extra cover
shorter on off. Leaves the batter late as Dhawan advances and taps it towards cover point
length just outside off. A bit of shape away and Dhawan accounts for it, defending into the off side
